message: LOCAL PRE-TRIAL A-CDM OPERATIONAL PROCEDURES ARE IN FORCE AT AP. -GROUND HANDLER (GH) ARE TO REPORT AND UPDATE TOBT (TARGET OFF-    BLOCK TIME).  -TSAT (TARGET START-UP APPROVAL TIME) WILL BE COMMUNICATED TO  AIRSPACE USER BY GROUND HANDLER (GH). -WHERE A-VDGS (ADVANCED VISUAL DOCKING GUIDANCE SYSTEM) IS AVAILABLE  TOBT AND TSAT WILL BE DISPLAYED. -THE PILOT SHALL REQUEST AN UPDATE TO THE TOBT FROM THE GROUND  HANDLER (GH) IF THE TOBT CANNOT BE MET AT ANY MOMENT. -THE PILOT SHALL ENSURE THAT THE AIRCRAFT WILL BE READY FOR START UP  CLEARANCE AND WILL HAVE CONTACT ON THE DELIVERY FREQUENCY WITHIN THE  TSAT WINDOW (+/-5 MINS). -DEPARTURE CLEARANCE (EXCEPT SQUAWK) SHALL BE AVAILABLE 18 MINUTES  BEFORE EOBT OR LATER. - THE PILOT SHALL CONTACT GROUND CONTROL FOR PUSH BACK OR TAXI  WITHIN 5 MIN FROM OBTAINING START UP CLEARANCE (ASAT).  - IF NO PUSH BACK OR TAXI REQUESTED AT ASAT+5, TSAT WILL EXPIRE, AND  A NEW TOBT WILL BE REQUIRED FOR THE FLIGHT TO BE INCLUDED IN THE  DEPARTURE SEQUENCE AND RECEIVE A NEW TSAT. -PUSH AND HOLD PROCEDURES WILL BE USED TO AVOID HOLDING ARRIVING  AIRCRAFT IN CASE OF OCCUPIED STANDS.
